sources.note: Nothing. Entry headed 'Quepo (?)': 'The same uncertainty as to linguistic distinction exists in regard to the people occupying the section known under this name as in the case of the Suerre.' Purely ethnohistorical (location per Peralta, conjectured Guetare affiliation); no linguistic data of any kind.

Quepo) are attested and how they are affiliated (Quepo usually conjectured Boruca- or Huetar-related on onomastic grounds); would document 'unattested' status first-hand. No stress content expected.

sources.note: Discusses the surviving materials for Huetar and neighbouring extinct groups; Thomas & Swanton/Peralta fold Quepo into Guetare (Huetar). Would state what, if anything, survives of Quepo. Not opened; no stress content expected for Quepo.
